note: County parcel services that can be searched by owner name (ArcGIS /query with a where clause), used by candidates.search_owner to find a tract the broker names only by its owner or tract name. Separate from parcel-services.json, which answers point lookups: a county can keep a statewide layer for points (TxGIO StratMap, identify-only, no owner search) and add its own service here. Reviewed by a person before it is added, like parcel-services.json. fields maps our roles to the service's columns.

48029.review_notes: From the discovery proposal parcel-proposals/48029.json (maps.bexar.org, score 105). Checked 2026-09-25: /query accepts UPPER(Owner) LIKE and an envelope, returns GeoJSON in EPSG:4326. Zip is the owner's mailing ZIP, not the parcel's: filter by geometry, never by that field. Added at Tucker's request (test batch 1 tract search).
